title: Alhambra is fascinating
text:
Alhambra place, including the gardens and palaces are amazing.  Well worth the visit, coming from Sevilla.   
Our tour was punctual with no delays. 
Juan was a great guide.
author: Fernando G

title: A real booking with actual tickets!
text:
We really enjoyed the tour - Andy was super knowledgeable and spoke at least 3 languages. He clearly had a friendly relationship with staff at the Alhambra. The ride was long - about 3 hours - but comfortable & included sensible pit stops. The group was very accommodating about pickup and drop off to fit the tour into people’s various travel plan. There were about 12 of us, not too big. This is a beautiful site and well worth the visit. 

Probably the most important thing to be wary of is fake postings - our first booking canceled on us last minute due to a “glitch,” which had us scrambling. T
